Description

Uses on-board machine learning to enhance capability over existing Earth imaging systems. In addition to providing traditional ~1m ground resolution imaging, Skyris uses onboard machine learning to perform change detection, identifying changes due to major events, such as floods and earthquakes, or subtle activities such as illegal logging and reclaimed land.
